capability: Deterministic structural-applicability gate for coating-formulation molecule candidates. For every declared candidate (SMILES + role + optional RDKit-normalized MoleculeFactsV1), design_gate_result computes four boolean gates (explicit_role, valid_single_component, role_appropriate_reactivity, pass_all_hard) plus a categorical gate_reason across six defined values. Phase-0 covers the mechanistic epoxy-amine cure chemistry admission rule (Wicks/Jones/Pappas 2007 Ch. 15, Ellis 1993 Ch. 6): resin iff oxirane_ring_count > 0; hardener iff reactive_amine_hydrogen_count > 0. Phase-1 would extend to live RDKit-normalized inputs once the pinned RDKit C++ 2026.03.2 boundary is provisioned.
population: Forty-two labelled molecule test cases spanning eight subgroups: 8 valid resins, 8 valid hardeners, 5 wrong-role declarations, 3 missing-role cases, 4 mismatched-resin (role=resin but no oxirane), 4 mismatched-hardener (role=hardener but no active amine hydrogens), 5 dual-functional glycidylamines admitted as either role, and 5 malformed lexical cases (empty SMILES, multi-fragment mixture, wildcard *, wildcard ~, missing structure and role). Structural molecules cited via PubChem CIDs.
split_methodology: No fitting — structural applicability is a mechanistic gate. The 42 test cases exhaustively partition the runtime's decision surface: 21 expected PASS cases (8 valid_resin + 8 valid_hardener + 5 dual_functional) and 21 expected FAIL cases (5 wrong_role + 3 missing_role + 4 mismatched_resin + 4 mismatched_hardener + 5 malformed_structure).
theory: Structural applicability for role X iff the molecule carries reactive group Y — the mechanistic basis of two-part epoxy-amine cure chemistry. Wicks, Jones & Pappas 2007 'Organic Coatings: Science and Technology' 4th ed. Chapter 15 §15.2-15.4 defines epoxy resin reactivity via the terminal oxirane ring; Ellis 1993 'Chemistry and Technology of Epoxy Resins' Chapter 6 §6.2 defines amine hardener reactivity via primary/secondary N–H bonds. This is not a model to be trained — it is the reaction mechanism. Every supplier TDS embeds the same accept/reject filter before quoting mix ratios.

metrics.name: gate_decision_correctness_rate
metrics.note: Fraction where evaluate(DESIGN_GATE_ID, ...).gates['pass_all_hard'] matches the expected label.

metrics.name: gate_reason_attribution_correctness_rate
metrics.note: Fraction where the categorical gate_reason exactly matches expected (six possible values: supported_single_component_with_role_appropriate_reactivity, missing_or_unsupported_role, missing_role_appropriate_reactive_group, empty_structure, multi_fragment_structure, wildcard_or_query_structure, missing_structure). A gate that reports 'fail' without a reason cannot be red-team-audited; this KPI verifies fine-grained reason correctness.

metrics.name: role_appropriate_reactivity_correctness_rate
metrics.note: Verifies gates['role_appropriate_reactivity'] agrees with expected (true iff role is valid AND matching reactive group present in facts).

metrics.name: explicit_role_correctness_rate
metrics.note: Verifies gates['explicit_role'] agrees with expected (true iff molecule.role ∈ {resin, hardener}).

metrics.name: valid_single_component_correctness_rate
metrics.note: Verifies gates['valid_single_component'] agrees with expected (true iff structure_text returns Ok without any ObviousStructureIssue). Independent of RDKit facts.

metrics.name: malformed_structure_fail_closed_rate
metrics.note: For the MALFORMED_STRUCTURE subgroup (empty SMILES, multi-fragment SMILES 'CC.O', wildcard '*', wildcard '~', missing structure), pass_all_hard must be false AND gate_reason must exactly match the ObviousStructureIssue category name. All five malformed probes correctly fail closed.

metrics.name: authority_lock_preservation_rate
metrics.note: Every output preserves evidence_scope == 'MOLECULE_STRUCTURAL_APPLICABILITY_ONLY' (on SCORED path) or 'MOLECULE_STRUCTURAL_REJECTION_ONLY' (on FAILED_GATES path); score_0_1 == None; objective_values empty; structural_applicability_only == true on SCORED path.

metrics.name: byte_stable_two_replay_rate
metrics.note: Observational. Every case invocation replayed twice back-to-back and asserted byte-identical ModuleResult via serde_json::to_vec equality.

fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.prediction_rule: explicit_role = role ∈ {resin, hardener}; valid_single_component = structure_text(candidate).is_ok(); role_appropriate_reactivity = (role == resin AND oxirane_ring_count > 0) OR (role == hardener AND reactive_amine_hydrogen_count > 0); pass_all_hard = explicit_role AND role_appropriate_reactivity AND valid_single_component AND facts present.
fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.note: Constraint satisfaction over structural predicates. No parameters to learn; theory is the epoxy-amine cure mechanism.
